items.briefing:
Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a customer data breach caused by a vulnerability in a third-party system, meaning guest information may have been exposed. If you've stayed at Quest recently, be alert to suspicious emails or unusual account activity. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) is warning that a software tool called N-able N-central is being actively exploited in Australia — organisations using this IT management platform should apply patches immediately. Professional services firms are also being flagged as the sector facing the highest volume of cyber intrusions.

**Practical tip:** If you receive unexpected emails referencing a recent hotel stay or booking, do not click any links — contact the company directly using details from their official website.

featured.title: Professional services face highest cyber intrusion volume
